title: f. 98, line 1: Miranda to Feria, "con este achaque, que siendo confidente ... Su Magestad"
caption: The first cipher line of fr. 3983 no. 45 (f. 98), group by group with the 1592 office key of fr. 3995 f. 97: en alla con es te · ca que que si en do con fi den te ? Su Magestad, that is “con este [a]chaque, que siendo confidente … Su Magestad”. The group before ca (the ring that gives cha) and the one before Su Magestad are not resolved; 50T is a nomenclature entry of the sheet.
key_note: Syllables of two digits, the consonant-vowel table of f. 97 (ba 10 ... zu 99); a dot after a group adds -n, ^ adds -s, a T marks a word of the nomenclature. Word spaces are added here.
